# Balance mod: the game's file, copied whole, with only the colony window's
# building lock added to each type's can_destroy (balance_building_not_kept).
# Generated by write_building_locks.py -- rerun it after every game update.
black_market = {
	allow = { balance_building_not_forbidden = { TYPE = black_market } }	# Balance mod: colony window build priorities
	audio_tier = 2
	is_foreign = yes
	stronger_power_projection = no
	max_levels = 10
	pop_type = peasants
	
	category = trade_category
	
	need_good_relation = yes
	
	employment_size = pirate_building_employment
	pop_size_created = pirate_building_employment

	rural_settlement = no
	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	country_potential = {
		has_reform = government_reform:pirate_brethren_reform
		modifier:enable_black_market_buildings = yes
	}
	location_potential = { is_coastal = yes }
	
	possible_production_methods = {
		black_market_maintenance
	}
	build_time = pirate_build_time
	
	modifier = {
		scaled_gold_to_building_owner = 0.05
		merchant_capacity_from_building = 2
	}
	can_destroy = { balance_building_not_kept = yes  # Balance mod: colony window building lock
	}
}
